title: The last day, the lot
logline: The mill's lot on the last day: forty pickups, then, in the next page that isn't drawn, none. The page draws the forty. Every make the strip would later put on 101, parked.

panels.composition: A gravel lot beside a mill full of forty pickups of every make parked in rows, the stack beyond, black spotting in the wet gravel.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a gravel lot beside a lumber mill full of pickup trucks of every make parked in rows with a brick stack beyond, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The forty. Then none, not drawn.
